<script>
cr.api(page => {
  const importantGoals = ['form', 'kviz', 'catalog'];
  let savedFormData = {};
  let processedForms = new Set();
  let fakeFormComponent = null;
  
  const now = Date.now();
  const oneMonth = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  const savedGoalData = localStorage.getItem('saved_goal');
  
  if (savedGoalData) {
    try {
      const goalData = JSON.parse(savedGoalData);
      if (now - goalData.timestamp > oneMonth) {
        localStorage.removeItem('saved_goal');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      localStorage.removeItem('saved_goal');
    }
  }
  
  function hasGoalInStorage() {
    const currentGoalData = localStorage.getItem('saved_goal');
    return currentGoalData !== null;
  }
  
  function createOverlay(el) {
    const buttons = $(el).find('button[data-action="send"]');
    
    if (buttons.length > 0) {
      const $button = buttons.last();
      
      if ($button.parent().find('> div[data-overlay="true"]').length > 0) {
        return;
      }
      
      const $overlay = $('<div>').attr('data-overlay', 'true').css({
        position: 'absolute',
        top: 0,
        left: 0,
        width: '100%',
        height: '100%',
        backgroundColor: 'transparent',
        zIndex: 9999,
        pointerEvents: 'all',
        cursor: 'pointer'
      });
      
      $overlay.on('click', function() {
        saveFormData(el, page.getComponent(el));
        
        if (fakeFormComponent && savedFormData[el]) {
          const phoneData = savedFormData[el].find(f => f.type === 'phone');
          
          if (phoneData) {
            fakeFormComponent.fields.forEach(field => {
              if (field.type === 'phone') {
                field.setValue(phoneData.value);
              }
            });
            
            fakeFormComponent.submit();
          }
        }
      });
      
      $button.parent().css('position', 'relative').append($overlay);
    }
  }
  
  function addOverlaysToAllForms() {
    $('.cr-form').each(function() {
      if (this.id !== 'fake-form') {
        createOverlay(this);
      }
    });
  }
  
  function waitForNewButtons() {
    page.waitForAppear('.cr-form button[data-action="send"]', (buttonEl) => {
      const formEl = $(buttonEl).closest('.cr-form')[0];
      
      if (formEl && formEl.id !== 'fake-form') {
        const $button = $(buttonEl);
        const hasOverlay = $button.parent().find('> div[data-overlay="true"]').length > 0;
        
        if (!hasOverlay && hasGoalInStorage()) {
          createOverlay(formEl);
        }
      }
    });
  }
  
  const hasGoal = hasGoalInStorage();
  
  page.waitForAppear('#fake-form', fakeFormEl => {
    fakeFormComponent = page.getComponent(fakeFormEl);
  });
  
  function saveFormData(el, form) {
    if (el.id === 'fake-form') return;
    
    savedFormData[el] = [];
    form.fields.forEach(field => {
      savedFormData[el].push({
        name: field.name,
        value: field.value,
        type: field.type
      });
    });
  }
  
  function handleForm(el) {
    if (el.id === 'fake-form') return;
    
    const formKey = el.outerHTML;
    if (processedForms.has(formKey)) return;
    processedForms.add(formKey);
    
    const form = page.getComponent(el);
    let blockSubmit = false;
    
    saveFormData(el, form);
    
    $(el).on('input change', () => saveFormData(el, form));
    
    form.on('before-submit', () => saveFormData(el, form));
    
    $(el).find('button[data-action="send"]').on('click', () => {
      saveFormData(el, form);
      blockSubmit = false;
    });
    
    if (hasGoalInStorage()) {
      createOverlay(el);
    }
    
    $(el).on('keydown', event => {
      if (event.keyCode === 13 && !$(event.target).is('button[data-action="send"]')) {
        blockSubmit = true;
        event.preventDefault();
        return false;
      }
    });
    
    form.on('before-submit', e => {
      if (blockSubmit) e.prevent();
    });
  }
  
  page.lazy('.cr-form', handleForm);
  page.waitForAppear('.cr-form', handleForm);
  
  page.on('form-submit', event => {
    const submitButton = $(event.form.el).find('button[data-action="send"]').last();
    const goal = submitButton.attr('data-ym_goal');
    
    if (goal && importantGoals.includes(goal)) {
      localStorage.setItem('saved_goal', JSON.stringify({
        goal: goal,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      }));
      
      setTimeout(addOverlaysToAllForms, 100);
      waitForNewButtons();
    }
  });
});
  </script>
<script>
cr.api(function (page) {
    page.waitForAppear('.not-a-robot', function (el) {
        const originalHrefs = new Map();
        const actionLink = el.querySelector('[data-action="link"]');
        const checkboxVisual = el.querySelector('[cr-field="radio-visual"]');

        if (actionLink) {
            originalHrefs.set(actionLink, actionLink.href);
        }

        if (!checkboxVisual) return;

        const updateLinkState = () => {
            setTimeout(() => {
                const checkboxes = checkboxVisual.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]');
                let selectedValues = [];
                
                checkboxes.forEach(checkbox => {
                    if (checkbox.checked) {
                        const item = checkbox.closest('[data-item-value]');
                        if (item) {
                            selectedValues.push(item.getAttribute('data-item-value'));
                        }
                    }
                });
                
                if (actionLink) {
                    actionLink.href = (selectedValues.length === 1 && selectedValues[0] === '1') 
                        ? originalHrefs.get(actionLink) || actionLink.href 
                        : '#';
                }
            }, 100);
        };

        const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
            mutations.forEach(mutation => {
                if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'checked') {
                    updateLinkState();
                }
            });
        });

        observer.observe(checkboxVisual, {
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ['checked'],
            subtree: true
        });

        checkboxVisual.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(checkbox => {
            checkbox.addEventListener('change', updateLinkState);
            checkbox.addEventListener('click', updateLinkState);
        });

        setTimeout(updateLinkState, 200);
    });

    const characters = 10 /* Минимальное количество цифр в номере телефона */
    const template = '+7 (000) 000-00-00'
    const startContent = '+7'

    $.jMaskGlobals = {}

        input.value = startContent + value
